issues.where: crop W, lower-right planetary limb; also visible in image-08.png, crop W
issues.what: A narrow cyan rim is separated from the bright face by a broad dark-blue trough. The two edges read as a detached shell rather than a continuous atmospheric falloff.
issues.fix: Blend the surface haze into the outer atmospheric glow so brightness falls off continuously, without a separate neon outline.

issues.where: crops A and H, cloud deck around and to the left of the central vortex; also visible in image-07.png, crops P and Q
issues.what: Cloud detail smears into broad directional streaks across the blue midtones, while the brightest nearby wisps retain much sharper edges. The mismatch makes parts of the cloud deck look stretched.
issues.fix: Reduce directional filtering on the cloud texture and restore fine, irregular structure across the midtones, not just along the bright wisps.

issues.where: crops U and X, foreground ring tracks
issues.what: A few thin, nearly parallel bright streaks stand out from the diffuse ring, especially the tapered marks in U, making them look like separate painted lines.
issues.fix: Vary the width and opacity of the narrow tracks and blend their ends into the surrounding ring dust.

issues.what: The moon's mottled texture is soft inside a relatively clean silhouette, with few sharply resolved pits or relief cues in the bright area.
issues.fix: Restore fine crater and relief detail on the lit face without sharpening the silhouette.

issues.where: ring system, both arcs (crops A, D, F, O, R, S)
issues.what: the rings are made of grainy, noisy speckle with faint repeated concentric streaks, so they look like a noise texture swept round an ellipse rather than particles or banded ringlets; at native size it reads as digital grain
issues.fix: build the rings from a radial density profile with clear ringlets and gaps, smooth the particle noise, and light them from the sun's side with a shadow cast by the planet

issues.where: planet disc, cloud streaks on the day side (crops B, H, J)
issues.what: the cloud features are soft, smeared brush strokes on a smooth airbrushed blue base; the storm near the top right looks pasted on and has no fine structure, so the surface reads as a painted decal
issues.fix: add fine banded detail along latitude lines, sharpen the cloud edges and give the storm a spiral structure that blends into the bands around it

issues.where: night-side ocean, lower left and bottom strip (crops D, M, R, S, T, U)
issues.what: the dark area is muddy and featureless, with fine diagonal streaky noise and a few stray bright specks that look like stars printed on the planet's surface
issues.fix: remove the specks on the surface, denoise the dark area and either add a clear terminator with city lights or real cloud shapes, or let it fall to clean black

issues.where: storm eye, centre (crops A, G, O)
issues.what: the eye is a smooth dark oval with soft swirling streaks and no eyewall clouds, so it looks like a hole smudged into the texture; the spiral bands are blurry, motion-smeared strokes
issues.fix: model a bright eyewall with towering clouds and sharp spiral rain bands, and make the eye a small, defined clear centre

issues.where: main cloud band, middle and right (crops E, H, N)
issues.what: the cloud ribbon has painterly, liquid-looking curls and wispy smearing with doubled light edges; the dark shadow band next to the right cloud streak is too even and sharp
issues.fix: give the clouds a cumulus texture with fine detail and soften and vary the cast shadow

issues.where: moon at right (crops C, G, K)
issues.what: the moon's dark disc is slightly larger than the lit crescent and shows a faint ring around its edge, which gives a doubled edge; the lit surface is smooth and airbrushed with no craters at native size
issues.fix: match the dark-side outline to the lit limb, remove the halo and add crater and albedo detail

issues.where: left limb and top limb glow (crops B, I, J)
issues.what: the atmosphere glow is an even soft halo of the same width all round the lit limb, which makes it look like a blur filter
issues.fix: make the glow thinner and brighter toward the sun, fading it out over the terminator

issues.where: upper right limb and sky (crops C, F, K)
issues.what: the stars are mostly clean, but a few bright stars have soft blobby glows and the Milky Way patch looks like a stamped texture
issues.fix: make the stars point-like with consistent PSFs and blend the Milky Way more gradually
